name: Browser Use - AI Web Agent
description: Stealth AI browser agent for autonomous navigation, data extraction, form interaction, and multi-step web automation powered by Browser Use V4.
author: Epic Think AI Team

tools.name: browser_run_task
tools.description: Execute an autonomous multi-step browser task (e.g. search, click, extract, fill forms) using Browser Use V4 with GPT-6 Luna or bu-ultrafast.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to any URL using stealth browser settings, extracting clean page content, title, and headers.

tools.name: browser_extract
tools.description: Extract structured data, tables, listings, or schemas from any target webpage.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a visual snapshot or screenshot of a webpage with customizable viewports.

tools.name: browser_get_task_status
tools.description: Retrieve step-by-step logs, live browser view URL, and progress of an active Browser Use task.

tools.name: browser_cancel_run
tools.description: Cancel an in-progress Browser Use task run to stop execution and prevent credit waste.

tools.name: browser_stop
tools.description: Stop a managed cloud browser instance to release resources.
